Narrative perspective is used as a tool of authorial intent to communicate and influence perception.

Benito Cereno is the story of Africans newly caught in slavery told by the white man.

Sexuality is a little more complex in Americanah.

Christopher medal given to Meka is a mere pretense and official ritual to compensate him for his lost land and children, in furtherance of the French cause in the colony.

Ferdinand Oyono's Houseboy is a quintessential narrative when it comes to exploring the cultural clash occasioned by the French policy of assimilation in Francophone Africa.

Blaine is the archetypal intellectual black American activist and crusader for the fundamental human rights and advancement of the native black Americans.

Ifemelu's blog is a key stylistic device functioning as her soapbox where she seemingly expresses herself, free from authorial intrusion.

Achebe's No Longer at Ease is the story of Obi Okonkwo, two generations away from the Okonkwo of Things Fall Apart.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the literature produced by citizens of a particular nation."
National Literature is the literature produced by citizens of a particular nation.
